reason: I have one or two chairs and I cut hair myself, so I already know who is in the chair and what is in the drawer. No owner I know uses this, and I am not paying ₹4,999 plus ₹999 every month for an app nobody around me has tried.
objection: What if the phone breaks or the company shuts down and I lose all my customer numbers and wallet money? My register doesn't disappear.
would_change_my_mind: If another salon owner I know, or my product distributor, was already using it and showed me it keeps the data safe even when the phone is lost.
